# Google Arts & Culture

> > A digital platform providing access to high-resolution artwork, historical artifacts, cultural exhibitions, and interactive experiences from museums and cultural institutions worldwide.

Google Arts & Culture partners with over 2,000 cultural institutions to digitize and showcase their collections, offering features like Art Transfer, Pocket Galleries, and Art Selfie. The platform spans diverse content including historical maps, biographical profiles of cultural figures, classical music archives, and thematic exhibitions covering art history, world geography, and independence movements.

## Key Topics

- Art Transfer
- Pocket Galleries
- Art Selfie
- Historical maps and cartography
- Persian Empire and ancient history
- Classical music and opera
- Independence movements
- Museum collections
- Cultural heritage digitization
- Performing arts
- World geography
- Historical figures and biographies
- Pakistan history
- Central Asian culture
- Interactive cultural experiences

## Historical Maps & Geography

- [Persian Empire Map](https://artsandculture.google.com/asset/persian-empire-map/MgFeSMvQtkbbWQ): Historical map of Persian Empire from museum collection
- [World Political Map](https://artsandculture.google.com/asset/world-political-map/4gFbpjL2N5Xc7Q?hl=en): World political map with cultural context on Nowruz celebrations

## Historical Figures & Biographies

- [Muhammed Ali Cinnah](https://artsandculture.google.com/entity/muhammed-ali-cinnah/m023vtj?hl=tr): Pakistan founding father Muhammad Ali Jinnah historical profile
- [Paul Agnew](https://artsandculture.google.com/entity/пол-агнью/m0265fz_?hl=uk): Scottish operatic tenor Paul Agnew profile with Les Arts Florissants
